concepts.name: Lift-out two-bag laundry sorter
concepts.title: Lift-out two-bag laundry sorter
concepts.recommendation: Prototype two independent lift-out bags with visible fabric-care labels and serviceable handles. Sorting and removable bags already exist; the difference must be easier removal in a smaller measured footprint.
dimensions: 5 kg per bag screening target; unvalidated
changes: Sorting
Tota and Bo already offer two compartments.
Two removable 30 L bags with text and shape labels, independent of color.
Timed sorting task and error count against purchased 2-bin benchmarks.
Footprint
Tota lists 560 × 395 mm footprint, 90 L total.
520 × 350 mm footprint with lower 60 L target volume; no capacity-equivalence claim.
Measure usable fill and floor area together.
Service
No verified cross-brand spare compatibility.
Replaceable webbing and individually coded bags.
Loaded carry cycling and replacement-time trial.
concepts.why: Tota already combines two 45 L bags in a 560 × 395 mm footprint. This proposal tests a smaller 2 × 30 L format; the tradeoff is less volume, not a proven market gap.
concepts.shopper: Households comparing task fit, storage and serviceability before purchase.
concepts.pilot: Purchase the exact two benchmark variants, build ten A0 samples and test the specified household tasks under matched conditions.
concepts.successMetric: In a 20-household pilot, target 20% faster bag removal and replacement than the purchased comparator, with no more sorting errors. Proposed criteria, not results.
concepts.killCriterion: Stop if bag lift effort or durability is worse than the comparator, or confirmed retail economics fail.
concepts.targetBaseline: No validated Target assortment gap. Audit current Target national-brand and owned-brand SKUs, pack sizes, prices and availability in this category before an opportunity decision.
concepts.special: Laundry storage only. No child-safety, mold-resistance or load-bearing seating claim. Keep the lid removable without an entrapment latch.
concepts.materialNote: Specify fabric abrasion, seam strength, shrinkage, colorfastness and handle attachment. Frame resin, fasteners and stability require supplier review.
concepts.wallSpec: Canvas 350 g/m² target; frame walls 2.5 mm nominal. Sewing tolerances ±5 mm and molded tolerances require supplier approval.
concepts.finishDescription: Matte frame with woven fabric bags; contrast labels remain readable in every color.
